mapper.select:
select t.*, nvl(t.transaction_amount, 0) - nvl(t.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT, 0) as can_return_amount from csh_transaction t
and t.contract_id = #{contractId} AND t.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND t.reversed_flag = 'N' and nvl(t.transaction_amount, 0) - nvl(t.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT, 0) > 0
order by t.transaction_num
